items.question: Is MBBS abroad from these countries valid in India?
items.answer: Yes, all universities we recommend are NMC (National Medical Commission) recognized. After completing MBBS, students can appear for the FMGE/NEXT exam to practice in India.

items.question: What is the total cost of MBBS abroad?
items.answer: The total cost (including tuition, hostel, food & miscellaneous) usually ranges between ₹15 Lakh to ₹50 Lakh depending on the country and university. We provide complete transparent fee breakdowns.

items.question: How long does the admission process take?
items.answer: The entire process usually takes 2–6 months depending on the country, university, and how early you start. We recommend starting as early as possible after NEET results.
